title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) - Overview
content: # PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

metadata.parent_title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) - Overview
content:
## Overview
PM SVANidhi is a special micro-credit facility launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to provide affordable collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors affected by economic disruption.

metadata.parent_title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) - Eligibility Criteria
content:
## Eligibility Criteria
- **Target Beneficiaries:** Urban street vendors, hawkers, thelawalas, rehri-patri vendors selling goods like vegetables, fruits, ready-to-eat street food, tea, apparel, artisan products, barbers, and cobblers.
- **Location:** Vendors vending in urban areas, peri-urban, and rural surrounding areas.
- **Documents:** Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR).
- **Age:** 18 years and above.

metadata.parent_title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) - Loan Tranches and Benefits
content:
## Loan Tranches and Benefits
- **1st Tranche Loan:** Up to ₹10,000 with a 1-year repayment tenure.
- **2nd Tranche Loan:** Up to ₹20,000 on timely or early repayment of the 1st loan (tenure 18 months).
- **3rd Tranche Loan:** Up to ₹50,000 on timely repayment of the 2nd loan (tenure 36 months).
- **Interest Subsidy:** 7% interest subsidy credited directly to the vendor's bank account quarterly upon regular repayments.
- **Digital Cash Back:** Monthly cashback up to ₹100 (up to ₹1,200 annually) for conducting digital UPI transactions.
- **Collateral:** Zero collateral or guarantor required.

metadata.parent_title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) - How to Apply
content:
## How to Apply
1. Check eligibility on `https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in`.
2. Apply through Common Service Centers (CSC), Urban Local Bodies, or banking correspondents.
3. Link mobile with Aadhaar for Aadhaar-based e-KYC.

metadata.parent_title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) - Official Portal & Source
content:
## Official Portal & Source
- Official Portal: https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in
- Ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) - Overview
content: # Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

metadata.parent_title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) - Overview
content:
## Overview
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme. It provides health cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and empaneled private hospitals in India.

metadata.parent_title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) - Key Objectives
content:
## Key Objectives
- Protect vulnerable and economically poor families from catastrophic health expenditures.
- Provide cashless and paperless access to healthcare services at empaneled hospitals.
- Strengthen public healthcare infrastructure and primary health centers (Ayushman Arogya Mandirs).

metadata.parent_title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) - Eligibility Criteria
content:
## Eligibility Criteria
- **Age:** No restriction on age (all family members covered).
- **Family Size:** No cap on family size or gender.
- **Economic Criteria:** Based on Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) criteria:
  - Rural families living in kutcha houses, households without adult male members (16-59 years), female-headed households with no adult male member, SC/ST households, landless casual manual workers.
  - Urban categories: Ragpickers, domestic workers, street vendors, cobblers, construction workers, plumbers, transport workers, delivery workers.
  - State ration card holders under Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH).
- **Income Limit:** Generally annual family income below ₹2,50,000 or meeting BPL/SECC deprivation indicators.
- **Senior Citizens 70+:** Recently expanded to cover all senior citizens aged 70 and above, regardless of income, under a distinct Ayushman Vaya Vandana card with ₹5 Lakh health cover.
- **Applicable States:** All States and UTs except where state-specific schemes operate independently (e.g. West Bengal, Odisha - though some now integrating).

metadata.parent_title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) - Benefits Provided
content:
## Benefits Provided
- Cashless hospitalization cover of up to ₹5 Lakh per year per family.
- Covers medical examination, consultation, pre-hospitalization tests (up to 3 days), post-hospitalization medicine and care (up to 15 days).
- Covers more than 1,949 medical and surgical procedures including oncology, cardiology, neurosurgery, and orthopedics.
- All pre-existing health conditions are covered from day one.

metadata.parent_title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) - How to Check Eligibility and Apply
content:
## How to Check Eligibility and Apply
1. Visit the official portal `https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in` or download the Ayushman App.
2. Enter mobile number, Aadhaar number, or Ration Card number to search family records.
3. If eligible, complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP or biometric authentication.
4. Download the digital Ayushman Card immediately.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - Overview
content: # Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - Overview
content:
## Overview
Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) is the flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE) implemented by National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC). The objective is to enable Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that will help them secure a better livelihood.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - Key Objectives
content:
## Key Objectives
- Provide short-term skill training, recognition of prior learning (RPL), and special projects.
- Align training with National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF).
- Foster entrepreneurship and job placement for certified trainees.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - Eligibility Criteria
content:
## Eligibility Criteria
- **Age:** 15 to 45 years.
- **Nationality:** Citizen of India with valid Aadhaar card.
- **Education:** Open to candidates with basic school education (8th/10th/12th pass) or college dropouts looking for vocational skills.
- **Employment Status:** Unemployed youth or school/college dropouts.
- **Income Limit:** No strict upper income limit, but preference is given to economically disadvantaged youth.
- **Applicable States:** All States and Union Territories across India.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - Benefits and Financial Assistance
content:
## Benefits and Financial Assistance
- 100% free skill training sponsored by the Government.
- Government certification recognized across India and globally.
- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) stipend for eligible candidates during training.
- Placement assistance and post-placement support allowance.
- Accidental insurance coverage for 3 years for certified candidates.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - Sectors and Courses Covered
content:
## Sectors and Courses Covered
- Information Technology (IT-ITeS)
- Healthcare and Nursing Assistance
- Automotive and Electric Vehicles (EV)
- Agriculture and Food Processing
- Electronics and Hardware
- Apparel, Textiles, and Handloom
- Solar and Renewable Energy Installation

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - How to Apply
content:
## How to Apply
1. Visit the official Skill India Digital portal at `https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in`.
2. Register using mobile number and Aadhaar authentication.
3. Select desired skill course and nearest PMKVY Training Centre.
4. Complete the training and pass the assessment to receive certification and placement support.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) - Official Portal & Source
content:
## Official Portal & Source
- Official Portal: https://www.skillindiadigital.gov.in
- Ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) - Overview
content: # Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) - Overview
content:
## Overview
PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme launched to supplement the financial needs of landholding farmers in procuring inputs for agricultural and allied activities, as well as domestic needs.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) - Key Objectives
content:
## Key Objectives
- Augment farmers' income and prevent distress selling.
- Support timely input purchases for Kharif and Rabi cropping seasons.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) - Eligibility Criteria
content:
## Eligibility Criteria
- **Target Beneficiaries:** All landholding farmer families having cultivable land in their name.
- **Exclusion Criteria:**
  - Institutional landholders.
  - Farmer families holding constitutional posts.
  - Present or retired officers/employees of State/Central Government and PSUs (excluding multi-tasking staff / Class IV).
  - Income tax payers of last assessment year.
  - Doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants, and architects registered with professional bodies.
  - Monthly pension of ₹10,000 or more for retired pensioners.
- **Applicable States:** All States and UTs across India.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) - Benefits Provided
content:
## Benefits Provided
- Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred directly to bank accounts.
- Paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months:
  - Period 1: April to July
  - Period 2: August to November
  - Period 3: December to March
- 100% funding by the Government of India via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) - How to Apply
content:
## How to Apply
1. Visit the PM-KISAN portal at `https://pmkisan.gov.in`.
2. Click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
3. Enter Aadhaar number, mobile number, and select rural or urban farmer.
4. Upload land records (Khasra/Khatauni) and bank account details.
5. Mandatory e-KYC must be completed using Aadhaar OTP or facial recognition via PM-KISAN mobile app.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) - Official Portal & Source
content:
## Official Portal & Source
- Official Portal: https://pmkisan.gov.in
- Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) - Overview
content: # Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) - Overview
content:
## Overview
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a Government of India backed small savings scheme initiated under the "Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao" campaign to build a fund for the education and marriage of a girl child.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) - Key Rules & Eligibility Criteria
content:
## Key Rules & Eligibility Criteria
- **Age of Girl Child:** Up to 10 years at the time of opening the account (with 1 year grace period during initial launch).
- **Nationality:** Indian resident girl child.
- **Account Limit:** Maximum of two accounts per family (one for each girl child). Exception for triplets or twins born in first or second delivery.
- **Guardian:** Account opened and operated by natural or legal guardian until girl reaches 18 years.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) - Financial Terms and Benefits
content:
## Financial Terms and Benefits
- **Minimum Deposit:** ₹250 per financial year.
- **Maximum Deposit:** ₹1,50,000 per financial year.
- **Interest Rate:** High sovereign interest rate (currently ~8.2% per annum, compounded annually).
- **Tax Benefit:** Triple E (EEE) tax exemption under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act (deposit exempt, interest exempt, maturity amount exempt).
- **Tenure:** Account matures after 21 years from date of opening or upon marriage of the girl child after age 18.
- **Partial Withdrawal:** Up to 50% of the balance permitted for higher education after girl reaches 18 years or passes 10th standard.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) - How to Open Account
content:
## How to Open Account
- Open at any Post Office or authorized Commercial Bank (SBI, PNB, BoB, etc.) with girl's birth certificate and guardian's KYC.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) - Official Portal & Source
content:
## Official Portal & Source
- Portal: India Post / Reserve Bank of India
- Ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Women and Child Development

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) - Overview
content: # Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) - Overview
content:
## Overview
Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) provides collateral-free loans up to ₹10 Lakh (recently expanded to ₹20 Lakh under Union Budget for past borrowers) to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) - Categories of MUDRA Loans
content:
## Categories of MUDRA Loans
1. **Shishu:** Loans up to ₹50,000 (ideal for new startups, small shops, roadside stalls).
2. **Kishore:** Loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5,00,000 (for purchasing equipment, machinery, inventory).
3. **Tarun:** Loans above ₹5,00,000 and up to ₹10,00,000 / ₹20,00,000 (for expansion and scaling up business).

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) - Eligibility Criteria
content:
## Eligibility Criteria
- **Age:** 18 years to 65 years.
- **Beneficiaries:** Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector activities.
- **Excluded:** Large corporations and agricultural farming (allied activities like dairy, poultry, fishery are included).
- **Collateral:** No collateral security or third-party guarantee required.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) - Benefits
content:
## Benefits
- No processing fee for Shishu loans.
- Access to formal banking credit without pledging physical assets.
- MUDRA Card (RuPay Debit Card) provided for working capital withdrawals.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) - Official Portal & Source
content:
## Official Portal & Source
- Official Portal: https://www.mudra.org.in
- Portal for Application: https://www.udyamimitra.in

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2) - Overview
content: # National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2) - Overview
content:
## Overview
National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) aims to promote apprenticeship training in the country, providing financial support to enterprises and stipends to youth undergoing industrial on-the-job training.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2) - Eligibility Criteria
content:
## Eligibility Criteria
- **Age:** Minimum 14 years (18 years for designated hazardous industries). Upper age usually not strictly capped, typically youth aged 14 to 35.
- **Educational Qualification:** 5th pass, 8th pass, 10th pass, 12th pass, ITI pass, Diploma, or Degree holders depending on the designated trade.
- **Aadhaar:** Aadhaar linked bank account is mandatory for receiving Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) stipend.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2) - Key Benefits
content:
## Key Benefits
- **Hands-on Industry Exposure:** Practical experience in manufacturing, automotive, electronics, logistics, retail, healthcare, etc.
- **Government Stipend Support:** Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of 25% of prescribed stipend up to ₹1,500 per month per apprentice directly to the apprentice's bank account.
- **Recognized Certification:** National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) issued by NCVT / MSDE upon completion.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2) - How to Apply
content:
## How to Apply
1. Register on the Apprenticeship India Portal `https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in`.
2. Complete e-KYC and profile creation.
3. Search and apply for apprenticeship vacancies across registered companies and public sector undertakings.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2) - Official Portal & Source
content:
## Official Portal & Source
- Official Portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
- Ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
